description.value: Liuyishou Hotpot is the Richmond, BC outpost of a large international Chinese hotpot chain with locations across North America. The restaurant offers all-you-can-eat dine-in hotpot with both lunch set menus and dinner AYCE options, where guests cook a variety of ingredients in shared broth pots at the table. It is a substantial sit-down establishment in a Richmond strip mall, likely appealing to cyclists looking for a hearty, social meal.
